$schema-comment: Wave 6a Task 1 bundle budgets. Sizes in BYTES: gzipped for maxGzipBytes rules, raw for maxRawBytes rules. The KB figures in the rationales are KiB (1024 B), as npm run check:bundle prints them. Edited via PR with rationale per docs/operations/bundle-budget.md.

rules.label: main entry
rules.rationale: Measured with Sentry on, as production ships (plan M6, 2026-10-17): CI now builds with a stand-in VITE_SENTRY_DSN. Before, CI built without a DSN, so main.jsx's `if (SENTRY_DSN)` folded away and Sentry.init with its tracing and replay integrations was never measured; with a DSN the entry was 213.62 KB against the 140,450 B cap. Session Replay now loads as its own lazy chunk (sentry replay rule), so the entry is 174.22 KB (178,399 B), of which ~40 KB is the SDK core and browserTracingIntegration, which stays eager so the pageload is traced. Without a DSN the same tree measures 134.19 KB. Cap 190,000 B (185.55 KB): ~11.6 KB of headroom at the time, and Replay back in the entry fails it. @sentry/react 11.8.0 (2026-10-19): 179.75 KB, so ~5.8 KB of headroom now. Earlier history (measured without a DSN): Current 114.38 KB (117,125 B) against a 140,450 B (137.16 KB) cap, since the mock client moved out of main (task #69): supabaseClient.js now loads mockSupabaseClient.js with a dynamic import, so the mock is a lazy chunk (~22.7 KB gz) fetched only in mock mode and not emitted at all by a build with both credentials. Before that it measured 140,445-140,452 B depending on content-hash noise, and a lazy-chunk edit elsewhere once tipped it 2 B over the cap (the build used for the table in docs/operations/bundle-budget.md measured 140,447 B). The cap is not yet tightened. The regex also matches a ~965 B lazy shared chunk named index-*.js (imported by the game, practice and team-analysis pages). The rule is firstPaint, so it only matches the entry script dist/index.html loads: the lazy chunk is printed as SKIP and is neither checked under this label nor counted in the first-paint total (both files are index-<hash>.js, so no regex alone can separate them). History -- Redesign: 131.1 KB after the Lightning-class chrome (TopBar/SideNav/navigation) plus expanded mock-client seeds & RPC handlers, which ship in main because supabaseClient imports the mock statically. 140 KB cap leaves ~9 KB for remaining phases; follow-ups: dynamic-import the mock client and route-split chart-vendor, then tighten. +100 B (fix #64): the strict PGRST201 practice_slots embed check in the mock, which ships in main for the reason above; measured 136.55 -> 136.76 KB after two compaction passes. +350 B (8.6 3b PR 2, coach practice preferences): the page itself is React.lazy and its mock RPC arms sit behind the DEV/mock guard (measured: 0 B in main), so what ships in main is only the lazy route with its __vite__mapDeps preload list, two nav entries and two permission constants; measured 136.78 -> 137.10 KB. Reusing an already-imported nav icon was tried first (no measurable change). +0.97 KB (heat forecast): the lazy route, one nav item and icon, the heat_forecast flag and its catalog row, and SideNav reading useFeatures for the nav item's feature gate; the page, hooks, model and NWS client are lazy. Measured 115.35 KB (cap unchanged).

rules.label: main css
rules.rationale: Redesign ships the Lightning-class design system (light+dark tokens + chrome/grid/page component CSS) in the main stylesheet. Current 21.05 KB (21.7 KB after Phase 1); the 30,000 B (29.30 KB) cap leaves ~8.2 KB; revisit after Phase 9.

rules.label: chart vendor
rules.rationale: Current 116.12 KB; 130,000 B (126.95 KB) cap. Lazy: not modulepreloaded, not in first paint. F-4-02 follow-up (route-split) targets <50 KB; tighten then.

rules.label: sentry replay (lazy; emitted only when VITE_SENTRY_DSN is set)
rules.rationale: Sentry Session Replay, split out of the main entry (frontend/src/lib/sentryReplay.js, plan M6): main.jsx imports it dynamically after Sentry.init and adds it with Sentry.addIntegration. Not first paint. Current 40.30 KB on @sentry/react 11.8.0 (2026-10-19; 40.19 KB, 41,159 B, on 10.76.2); cap = actual x 1.2 rounded up to the next 1,000 B. A build without VITE_SENTRY_DSN emits no such chunk, so this rule's [NO MATCH] is the gate refusing to measure a shape production does not ship: build as CI does (docs/operations/ci-cd.md).

rules.label: supabase vendor
rules.rationale: Current 48.51 KB; 60,000 B (58.59 KB) cap absorbs minor SDK growth.

rules.label: react vendor
rules.rationale: Current 16.92 KB; 25,000 B (24.41 KB) cap absorbs React 19.x patch growth.

rules.label: lucide vendor
rules.rationale: Added with the zero-match gate: index.html modulepreloads this chunk, so it is first paint, but no rule matched it and it was neither budgeted nor counted. Current 7.63 KB (7,810 B); cap = actual x 1.2 rounded up to the next 1,000 B.

rules.label: virtual vendor
rules.rationale: Added with the zero-match gate: @tanstack/react-virtual manualChunk (lazy), previously matched by no rule. Current 5.04 KB (5,158 B); cap = actual x 1.2 rounded up to the next 1,000 B.

rules.label: heat turbidity table
rules.rationale: Heat forecast Linke turbidity climatology (packages/core/src/heat/data/), 12 months x 114 x 240 uint8 = 328,320 B exactly; decodeTurbidityTable refuses any other length, so growth means a deliberate regeneration. Fetched only by the heat forecast page (lazy, not first paint); ~115 KB if the host compresses it. Cap = actual + ~3.5%.

rules.label: images (any png)
rules.rationale: F-4-03 resolved by the redesign rebrand: SL-Logo assets are quantized PNGs (current 5.47 KB). 100,000 B cap guards against future unoptimized image additions.

rules.label: fonts (woff2)
rules.rationale: Self-hosted Public Sans variable fonts (CSP font-src 'self'): upright 26.20 KB + italic 27.63 KB, latin subset. Cap 35,000 B (34.18 KB) per file; woff2 is already compressed so raw bytes are gated.

totalFirstPaintRationale: Measured with Sentry on, as production ships (plan M6, 2026-10-17): 277.44 KB (284,101 B) with Session Replay lazy; 282.25 KB on @sentry/react 11.8.0 (2026-10-19), ~6.8 KB under the cap; it was 316.84 KB with Replay in the entry, and 237.41 KB without a DSN, the shape CI used to measure. Cap 296,000 B (289.06 KB). Earlier history (measured without a DSN): Sum of the gzip size of every file dist/index.html loads (entry module script, modulepreloads, stylesheets); each must be matched by a firstPaint rule (main entry, main css, react vendor, lucide vendor, supabase vendor). Measured 208.43 KB (213,435 B) after the mock client moved out of main (task #69); 231.21 KB (236,757 B) before (was 224.52 KB under the old label-based sum, which counted the ~965 B lazy index-*.js chunk and missed the modulepreloaded lucide-vendor, 7,810 B); cap 250,000 B (244.14 KB).
